subsystems.name: Sensing layer
subsystems.role: measures what the city is doing — traffic, air quality, waste, energy and water.

subsystems.name: Connectivity
subsystems.role: carries sensor data cheaply and reliably across a city.

subsystems.name: Data platform
subsystems.role: collects, stores and fuses data from many city systems.

subsystems.name: Analytics and AI
subsystems.role: turns raw data into decisions — forecasts, optimisation and anomaly detection.

subsystems.name: Actuation and control
subsystems.role: acts on the analysis to cut energy and resource use.

subsystems.name: Interfaces and governance
subsystems.role: lets operators and citizens see and use the data, with privacy and security safeguards.

buildSteps.title: Set goals and baseline
buildSteps.detail: Decide which resource to improve — energy, waste or traffic — and measure today's consumption and service levels.

buildSteps.title: Instrument the city
buildSteps.detail: Install sensors and meters: air-quality monitors, bin-fill sensors, smart streetlights, traffic detectors and building meters.

buildSteps.title: Build the network
buildSteps.detail: Roll out LoRaWAN or NB-IoT gateways and fibre backhaul so data flows from every sensor to the platform.

buildSteps.title: Stand up the data platform
buildSteps.detail: Ingest and clean the data, link it to maps and city records, and build a digital twin of the district.

buildSteps.title: Develop the analytics
buildSteps.detail: Train models to predict traffic, forecast energy demand and optimise waste-collection routes.

buildSteps.title: Connect the controls
buildSteps.detail: Integrate analytics with lighting controllers, traffic signals and building systems so the city can act automatically.

buildSteps.title: Pilot and measure
buildSteps.detail: Run a district-scale trial, compare resource use against the baseline, and fix what does not work.

buildSteps.title: Scale and govern
buildSteps.detail: Extend city-wide, publish open data, and enforce privacy and cybersecurity rules.

prerequisites.tech: Low-cost IoT sensors and low-power networks
prerequisites.why: cheap sensors and LoRaWAN or NB-IoT make city-wide instrumentation affordable.
